name: OmniStar
description: OmniStar is a comprehensive dataset for training and benchmarking online video understanding, covering 15 diverse real-world scenarios and 5 evaluation tasks designed to evaluate live streaming video-language models.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for online video understanding that is useful for live-streaming and proactive multimodal systems, but is not yet widely standardized in the broader community.
notes: Dataset designed for online video understanding with multiple tasks and scenarios; supports evaluation of live streaming assistants.
